excluded_from_primary_challenge.reason: Retain ordered EF1/EF3/EF4 vector only; protein-level Mn-competing site not mapped to individual crystal sites.
Opposing La/Ca labels unverified; cooperative occupancy paths and WT/N56A/P43M constructs must not be mixed.
La site constants plus cross-study Ca support do not form a same-assay La/Ca truth pair.
Real constants exist, but Ca/La pH and assay differences and unverified exact graft structures block clean direction labels.
ConA qualitative exclusion is conditional on Mn/dimer state and assay limit; HRP La-specific direction/site unresolved. Neither is a clean numeric challenge.
Strong protein-level La/Ca evidence and9VY7, but five coupled La sites lack mapped per-site constants; do not count five positives.
Verified La structures/within-Ln preferences are not verified La/Ca labels.
Competitive metal retention preprint is protein-level occupancy, not microscopic affinity; superstoichiometric La and holo-model/construct gaps remain.
Keep functional/cofactor association separate from solution-affinity challenge; canonical composition/motif separation cannot demonstrate incremental information.

recommendation: Use GGR/alpha as the consumed development anchor; prioritize the neutral LanM perturbation for evidence/input completion, with PqqT as a numeric same-assay but charge-confounded family. No fresh fully mapped matched-composition binary panel was verified.
